PAGE TITLE: FINANCIAL SECTION | INDEPENDENT AUDITORS' REPORT

KEY FACTS:
- An audit identified a material weakness in financial reporting oversight controls at NASA.
- A routine accrual for contract costs was posted to the financial management system in an amount that misstated the accounts payable line item by $254 million.
- The posting for the September accrual was not corrected until November 2024.
- Government Accountability Office (GAO) Standards of Internal Control for the Federal Government Principle 12 relates to Implement Control Activities.
- Principle 16 relates to Perform Monitoring Procedures.
